texts.game: Your Xbox 360 disc of Blur as an .iso, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xex, cache/, levels/, layer1/ and Ui/).
texts.update: Blur's title update 2, the last one: the port is made from its code. Choose the Xbox 360 package (a LIVE file named like TU_10LC225_...), the folder that holds it, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xexp, loc.pak and gamedata/).
texts.dlc: The game's downloadable content, as the Xbox 360 packages you have (LIVE files), or a folder of them. The game installs them at its first start. Not tested with any yet.
texts.create: The shaders are made from your game's own files on all of this computer's cores, and the level files are packed with LZ4 (the game reads them as they were; the rest of Blur's data is compressed already). The zip downloads while it is written.
texts.settings: The game writes its settings file, blur.toml, at its first start: the language, the frame rate cap, the resolutions, SMAA, MSAA, four-core mode and the buttons. Hold A+B+X+Y+L+R during the game to open its menu.
